# CalcTool.org

> A comprehensive physics and engineering calculator collection spanning classical mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, quantum mechanics, and specialized fields like astrophysics and fluid dynamics.

CalcTool.org provides specialized calculators for scientists, engineers, and students across physics, chemistry, and mathematics. The site covers fundamental laws (Newton's, Coulomb's, Snell's), advanced topics (relativity, quantum mechanics), and practical engineering tools for real-world applications.

## Key Topics

- Physics
- Engineering
- Astrophysics
- Thermodynamics
- Electromagnetism
- Fluid Mechanics
- Quantum Mechanics
- Relativity
- Kinematics
- Unit Conversion
- Atmospheric Science
- Orbital Mechanics
- Optics
- Electronics
- Molecular Chemistry

## Unit Conversion & Fundamentals

- [Conversion calculators](https://www.calctool.org/conversion): Unit conversion tools for angles, areas, bytes, density and more
- [Math and statistics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/math-and-statistics): Math and statistics tools: geometry, trigonometry, probability, volumes

## Classical Mechanics & Dynamics

- [Kinematics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/kinetics): Kinematics calculators: projectile motion, free fall, SUVAT equations
- [Dynamics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/dynamics): Dynamics calculators: Newton's Second Law, Coriolis Effect, momentum, friction
- [Rotational and periodic motion calculators](https://www.calctool.org/rotational-and-periodic-motion): Rotational motion: angular momentum, harmonic motion, oscillating systems
- [Continuum mechanics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/continuum-mechanics): Continuum mechanics calculators: Hooke's Law, Young's Modulus, Mohr's Circle
- [Machines and mechanisms calculators](https://www.calctool.org/machines-and-mechanisms): Machines and mechanisms: belt length, bolt torque, mechanical advantage

## Thermodynamics & Atmospheric Science

- [Thermodynamics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/thermodynamics): Thermodynamics: Boyle's Law, Carnot Efficiency, gas laws, entropy
- [Atmospheric thermodynamics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/atmospheric-thermodynamics): Atmospheric thermodynamics tools: humidity, air density, pressure, dew point

## Electromagnetism & Electronics

- [Electromagnetism calculators](https://www.calctool.org/electromagnetism): Electromagnetism calculators: Coulomb's Law, Faraday's Law, Lorentz Force
- [Electrical energy calculators](https://www.calctool.org/electrical-energy): Electrical energy tools: AC wattage, battery capacity, capacitor energy
- [Electronics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/electronics): Electronics tools: Ohm's Law, RLC circuits, Wheatstone Bridge analysis

## Modern Physics & Space Science

- [Astrophysics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/astrophysics): Astrophysics calculators for Hubble's Law, Kepler's Third Law, Schwarzschild Radius
- [Relativity calculators](https://www.calctool.org/relativity): Relativity tools: E=mc², Lorentz Factor, time dilation, length contraction
- [Quantum mechanics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/quantum-mechanics): Quantum mechanics: Bohr Model, De Broglie Wavelength, Heisenberg Principle

## Waves, Optics & Fluid Dynamics

- [Waves calculators](https://www.calctool.org/waves): Waves calculators: Doppler Effect, Bragg's Law, diffraction, resonance
- [Optics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/optics): Optics calculators: Snell's Law, Brewster's Angle, lens design tools
- [Fluid mechanics calculators](https://www.calctool.org/fluid-mechanics): Fluid mechanics: Bernoulli Equation, Darcy-Weisbach, Drag Equation

## Chemistry

- [Physical chemistry calculators](https://www.calctool.org/physical-chemistry): Physical chemistry: Arrhenius Equation, pH buffer, molecular weight

## Optional

- [Other calculators](https://www.calctool.org/other): Miscellaneous calculators: BMI, VAT, health and finance utilities
